redCandidate.publicEntry: startLongRunningDelivery() from the rex-harness package entry point
redCandidate.setup: Declare a two-feature delivery with the dependent feature first and its prerequisite second, then start it with a verified zero-exit baseline receipt.
redCandidate.expected: The ledger preserves dependent.dependsOn as ['prerequisite'] and selects prerequisite as its sole current feature.
redCandidate.observed: The focused public test exits 1 because the initialized ledger omits dependent.dependsOn.
redCandidate.failureReason: Long-running delivery currently discards dependency declarations and activates the first declared feature, so it cannot enforce dependency-ready ordering.
